headline: The 60-day math is the reason to swipe, and every figure checks out. Slide 2 makes the reader wait for the point, so cut it to one line.

The three-payment split and 'Payroll Friday is boring now' are Dana's own.

Priya's words are hers, first name only, as her permission allows.

No banned phrases, no em dashes, the save pill is on slide 4.
